ZIP size limit 1048576 bytes; specified sole exact filename, listing count1/7d/private, measured archive digest and inflated bytes agree with API/log. Overall transport log max4194304. A body of 24576 is legal only if all semantic/shape rules also hold; never enlarge the body cap to fit LF.
